problem.title: 订单分页筛选

en.title: Filter Paged Orders
en.description:
The orders API filters by status and returns 10 orders per page:

```text
GET https://data.cswork.test/api/orders?status=<status>&page=<page>
```

```json
{"page": 1, "per_page": 10, "total": 41, "total_pages": 5,
 "data": [{"id": 1003, "customer": "ava", "status": "paid", "amount_cents": 4999, "created_at": "2026-03-14"}, ...]}
```

`status` is one of `pending`, `paid`, `shipped`, `cancelled`, `refunded`. With no orders, `total` and `total_pages` are 0 and `data` is empty.

Given a status and a minimum amount in cents, count the orders with that status whose amount is at least the minimum, and add up their amounts.

The judge has no internet access: the API answers from a fixed data set that ships with the problem. Python's `requests.get` and `urllib.request.urlopen` are answered by the judge itself; any other address returns HTTP 404 with a JSON error body. Python only.
en.input: One line: the status and the minimum amount in cents (an integer, 0 ≤ minimum ≤ 1000000), separated by a space.
en.output: Print two integers: the number of orders and the sum of their amounts in cents.
en.explanation: Sample 2: there are no refunded orders, so the API returns total_pages = 0.
hints: Fetch page 1 for total_pages, then every page up to the last.
"At least" includes orders equal to the minimum.

problem.description:
订单接口按状态过滤并分页返回，每页 10 条：

```text
GET https://data.cswork.test/api/orders?status=<status>&page=<页码>
```

```json
{"page": 1, "per_page": 10, "total": 41, "total_pages": 5,
 "data": [{"id": 1003, "customer": "ava", "status": "paid", "amount_cents": 4999, "created_at": "2026-03-14"}, ...]}
```

`status` 是 `pending`、`paid`、`shipped`、`cancelled`、`refunded` 之一。没有订单时 `total` 和 `total_pages` 都是 0，`data` 为空。

给定状态和金额下限（单位：分），统计该状态下金额不低于下限的订单数和它们的金额之和。

评测环境没有外网：接口返回的是题目自带的固定数据。Python 里的 `requests.get` 和 `urllib.request.urlopen` 由评测机直接应答，数据之外的地址返回 HTTP 404 和一段 JSON 错误信息。本题只支持 Python。
problem.input: 一行：状态和金额下限（0 ≤ 下限 ≤ 1000000 的整数，单位分），空格分隔。
problem.output: 输出两个整数：订单数和金额之和（分）。
problem.explanation: 样例 2：refunded 没有订单，接口返回 total_pages = 0。
hints: 先取第 1 页得到 total_pages，再取到最后一页。
“不低于”包含等于下限的订单。

problem.title: 月度净流入排行

en.title: Monthly Net Flow Ranking
en.description:
The transactions API returns every transaction, 10 per page, with no filters:

```text
GET https://data.cswork.test/api/transactions?page=<page>
```

```json
{"page": 1, "per_page": 10, "total": 128, "total_pages": 13,
 "data": [{"id": 50001, "user": "ava", "type": "credit", "amount": 2500, "date": "2026-03-14"}, ...]}
```

`type` is `credit` (money in, positive) or `debit` (money out, negative); `amount` is a positive integer.

Given a month `YYYY-MM` and k, compute each user's net flow in that month (credits minus debits), counting only users with a transaction that month. Print the top k by net flow, largest first, ties by user name in lexicographic order.

The judge has no internet access: the API answers from a fixed data set that ships with the problem. Python's `requests.get` and `urllib.request.urlopen` are answered by the judge itself; any other address returns HTTP 404 with a JSON error body. Python only.
en.input: One line: the month YYYY-MM and an integer k (1 ≤ k ≤ 100).
en.output: First line: m = min(k, number of users with a transaction that month); then m lines of "user net".
en.explanation: Sample 2: there are no transactions in 2025-12, so the answer is 0.
hints: Read every page before sorting: one user's transactions are spread across pages.
Sort by (−net, user) to break ties.

problem.description:
流水接口分页返回全部交易，每页 10 条，不支持过滤：

```text
GET https://data.cswork.test/api/transactions?page=<页码>
```

```json
{"page": 1, "per_page": 10, "total": 128, "total_pages": 13,
 "data": [{"id": 50001, "user": "ava", "type": "credit", "amount": 2500, "date": "2026-03-14"}, ...]}
```

`type` 为 `credit`（入账，记正）或 `debit`（出账，记负），`amount` 为正整数。

给定月份 `YYYY-MM` 和 k，计算每个用户在这个月的净流入（入账之和减出账之和），只统计这个月有交易的用户。按净流入从大到小输出前 k 名，相同时按用户名字典序。

评测环境没有外网：接口返回的是题目自带的固定数据。Python 里的 `requests.get` 和 `urllib.request.urlopen` 由评测机直接应答，数据之外的地址返回 HTTP 404 和一段 JSON 错误信息。本题只支持 Python。
problem.input: 一行：月份 YYYY-MM 和整数 k（1 ≤ k ≤ 100）。
problem.output: 第一行输出名次数 m = min(k, 有交易的用户数)；随后 m 行，每行“用户名 净流入”。
problem.explanation: 样例 2：2025-12 没有交易，输出 0。
hints: 所有页都要取完再排序：同一用户的交易分散在不同页。
按 (−净流入, 用户名) 排序即可处理并列。

problem.title: 团队余额前 k 名

en.title: Top Balances in a Team
en.description:
Two endpoints:

```text
GET https://data.cswork.test/api/users?team=<team>&page=<page>
GET https://data.cswork.test/api/accounts/<user_id>
```

The users endpoint filters by team and pages its results (10 per page; `total_pages` is 0 for an empty team):

```json
{"page": 1, "per_page": 10, "total": 14, "total_pages": 2,
 "data": [{"id": 103, "name": "Iris Lantern", "team": "atlas", "active": true}, ...]}
```

The accounts endpoint returns one user's account (every user has one):

```json
{"user_id": 103, "balance": 12000, "currency": "USD"}
```

Given a team and k, take the team's users whose `active` is true and list the top k by balance, highest first, ties by name in lexicographic order.

The judge has no internet access: the API answers from a fixed data set that ships with the problem. Python's `requests.get` and `urllib.request.urlopen` are answered by the judge itself; any other address returns HTTP 404 with a JSON error body. Python only.
en.input: One line: the team name and an integer k (1 ≤ k ≤ 100).
en.output: First line: m = min(k, number of active members); then m lines of "name balance" (a name has one space in it).
en.explanation: Sample 2: team fable has no members, so the answer is 0.
hints: Page through the team first, then look up each active member's account.
Looking up active members only saves requests.

problem.description:
两个接口：

```text
GET https://data.cswork.test/api/users?team=<team>&page=<页码>
GET https://data.cswork.test/api/accounts/<user_id>
```

用户接口按团队过滤并分页（每页 10 条，没有成员时 `total_pages` 为 0）：

```json
{"page": 1, "per_page": 10, "total": 14, "total_pages": 2,
 "data": [{"id": 103, "name": "Iris Lantern", "team": "atlas", "active": true}, ...]}
```

账户接口返回一个用户的账户（每个用户都有）：

```json
{"user_id": 103, "balance": 12000, "currency": "USD"}
```

给定团队和 k，找出该团队中 `active` 为 true 的用户，按余额从高到低取前 k 名，余额相同时按姓名字典序。

评测环境没有外网：接口返回的是题目自带的固定数据。Python 里的 `requests.get` 和 `urllib.request.urlopen` 由评测机直接应答，数据之外的地址返回 HTTP 404 和一段 JSON 错误信息。本题只支持 Python。
problem.input: 一行：团队名和整数 k（1 ≤ k ≤ 100）。
problem.output: 第一行输出 m = min(k, 活跃成员数)；随后 m 行，每行“姓名 余额”（姓名含一个空格）。
problem.explanation: 样例 2：fable 团队没有成员，输出 0。
hints: 先分页取完团队成员，再逐个查询活跃成员的账户。
只给活跃成员查账户，可以少发请求。

problem.title: 作者的文章与评论

en.title: An Author's Articles and Comments
en.description:
The articles API filters by author and pages its results, 10 per page:

```text
GET https://data.cswork.test/api/articles?author=<author>&page=<page>
```

```json
{"page": 2, "per_page": 10, "total": 11, "total_pages": 2,
 "data": [{"id": 7031, "author": "omar", "title": null, "story_title": "On harbors and signals", "num_comments": 12, "published": "2026-04-02"}]}
```

- An author with no articles has `total` and `total_pages` 0 and an empty `data`; the last page may hold fewer than 10 articles, or exactly 10.
- When `title` is null, use `story_title` as the title; an article with both null does not count.
- A null `num_comments` counts as 0.

Given an author and a minimum number of comments, consider that author's articles with at least that many comments: print how many there are, their total comments, and the title of the most commented one (ties: earlier `published`, then the lexicographically smaller title).

The judge has no internet access: the API answers from a fixed data set that ships with the problem. Python's `requests.get` and `urllib.request.urlopen` are answered by the judge itself; any other address returns HTTP 404 with a JSON error body. Python only.
en.input: One line: the author and an integer minimum (0 ≤ minimum ≤ 1000).
en.output: Line 1: the number of articles; line 2: their total comments; if there is at least one article, line 3: the most commented title.
en.explanation: Sample 1: omar has 11 articles, so page 2 holds just one. Sample 2: lin has no articles and total_pages is 0.
hints: Use total_pages as given, not total // per_page.
Title fallback: article["title"] or article["story_title"].

problem.description:
文章接口按作者过滤并分页，每页 10 条：

```text
GET https://data.cswork.test/api/articles?author=<author>&page=<页码>
```

```json
{"page": 2, "per_page": 10, "total": 11, "total_pages": 2,
 "data": [{"id": 7031, "author": "omar", "title": null, "story_title": "On harbors and signals", "num_comments": 12, "published": "2026-04-02"}]}
```

- 作者没有文章时 `total` 和 `total_pages` 都是 0，`data` 为空；最后一页可能不满 10 条，也可能正好满。
- `title` 为 null 时用 `story_title` 作标题；两者都为 null 的文章不计入。
- `num_comments` 为 null 时按 0 计。

给定作者和评论数下限，统计该作者评论数不低于下限的文章：文章数、评论总数，以及评论最多的文章标题（并列时取 `published` 较早的，再并列取标题字典序较小的）。

评测环境没有外网：接口返回的是题目自带的固定数据。Python 里的 `requests.get` 和 `urllib.request.urlopen` 由评测机直接应答，数据之外的地址返回 HTTP 404 和一段 JSON 错误信息。本题只支持 Python。
problem.input: 一行：作者名和整数下限（0 ≤ 下限 ≤ 1000）。
problem.output: 第一行文章数，第二行评论总数；文章数大于 0 时第三行输出评论最多的标题。
problem.explanation: 样例 1：omar 有 11 篇文章，第 2 页只有 1 篇。样例 2：lin 没有文章，total_pages 为 0。
hints: 总页数直接用 total_pages，不要用 total // per_page。
标题回退：article["title"] or article["story_title"]。

problem.title: 游标分页的事件统计

en.title: Events Behind a Cursor
en.description:
The events API pages with a cursor: the first request has no `cursor`; each next one passes the `next_cursor` of the page before, until it is null.

```text
GET https://data.cswork.test/api/events?type=<type>
GET https://data.cswork.test/api/events?type=<type>&cursor=<next_cursor>
```

```json
{"data": [{"id": 901, "type": "login", "user": "cai", "ts": 1767226012}, ...], "next_cursor": "3fa9c1"}
```

`type` is one of `login`, `purchase`, `upload`, `share`; with no events, `data` is empty and `next_cursor` is null. Cursors are opaque strings: you cannot guess them, only take them from the previous page.

Given a type and a time window [from, to] (Unix seconds, both ends included), print the number of distinct users with an event of that type in the window, and the user with the most such events (ties: the lexicographically smallest name; `-` if there are none).

The judge has no internet access: the API answers from a fixed data set that ships with the problem. Python's `requests.get` and `urllib.request.urlopen` are answered by the judge itself; any other address returns HTTP 404 with a JSON error body. Python only.
en.input: One line: the type, from and to (integers, 0 ≤ from ≤ to ≤ 10^10).
en.output: Line 1: the number of distinct users; line 2: the most active user, or `-`.
en.explanation: Sample 2: there are no share events, so the answer is 0 and -.
hints: Loop until next_cursor is null; do not guess page numbers.
Both ends of the window count: from ≤ ts ≤ to.

problem.description:
事件接口用游标分页：第一页不带 `cursor`，之后每次带上一页返回的 `next_cursor`，直到它为 null。

```text
GET https://data.cswork.test/api/events?type=<type>
GET https://data.cswork.test/api/events?type=<type>&cursor=<next_cursor>
```

```json
{"data": [{"id": 901, "type": "login", "user": "cai", "ts": 1767226012}, ...], "next_cursor": "3fa9c1"}
```

`type` 是 `login`、`purchase`、`upload`、`share` 之一；没有事件时 `data` 为空、`next_cursor` 为 null。游标是不透明的字符串，不能猜，只能从上一页拿。

给定类型和时间窗 [from, to]（Unix 秒，两端都包含），输出窗口内有该类事件的不同用户数，以及事件最多的用户（并列取用户名字典序最小者；没有事件时输出 `-`）。

评测环境没有外网：接口返回的是题目自带的固定数据。Python 里的 `requests.get` 和 `urllib.request.urlopen` 由评测机直接应答，数据之外的地址返回 HTTP 404 和一段 JSON 错误信息。本题只支持 Python。
problem.input: 一行：类型、from、to（0 ≤ from ≤ to ≤ 10^10 的整数）。
problem.output: 第一行不同用户数；第二行事件最多的用户名或 `-`。
problem.explanation: 样例 2：share 没有事件，输出 0 和 -。
hints: 循环直到 next_cursor 为 null，不要按页码猜。
时间窗两端都包含：from ≤ ts ≤ to。

problem.title: 按团队统计工单

en.title: Tickets by Team
en.description:
Two endpoints:

```text
GET https://data.cswork.test/api/tickets?page=<page>
GET https://data.cswork.test/api/agents/<agent_id>
```

The tickets endpoint pages through every ticket (10 per page, no filters):

```json
{"page": 1, "per_page": 10, "total": 58, "total_pages": 6,
 "data": [{"id": 3001, "title": "Iron signal issue", "priority": "high", "status": "open", "assignee": 7}, ...]}
```

`assignee` is an agent id or null. The agents endpoint returns `{"id": 7, "name": "...", "team": "billing"}`; a deleted agent answers HTTP 404.

Given some priorities and a status (`open`, `closed` or `any`), count the matching tickets per team: a ticket with no `assignee`, or whose agent was deleted (404), counts for the team `unassigned`. Print teams by count, highest first, ties by team name in lexicographic order.

The judge has no internet access: the API answers from a fixed data set that ships with the problem. Python's `requests.get` and `urllib.request.urlopen` are answered by the judge itself; any other address returns HTTP 404 with a JSON error body. Python only.
en.input: Line 1: comma-separated priorities (some of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `urgent`, no spaces); line 2: the status.
en.output: Line 1: the number of teams m; then m lines of "team count".
en.explanation: Sample 2: every ticket, counted by team.
hints: Check status_code first: a 404 agent has no "team".
Look each agent up once; cache the answers in a dict.

problem.description:
两个接口：

```text
GET https://data.cswork.test/api/tickets?page=<页码>
GET https://data.cswork.test/api/agents/<agent_id>
```

工单接口分页返回全部工单（每页 10 条，不支持过滤）：

```json
{"page": 1, "per_page": 10, "total": 58, "total_pages": 6,
 "data": [{"id": 3001, "title": "Iron signal issue", "priority": "high", "status": "open", "assignee": 7}, ...]}
```

`assignee` 是客服编号或 null。客服接口返回 `{"id": 7, "name": "...", "team": "billing"}`；已删除的客服返回 HTTP 404。

给定若干优先级和状态（`open`、`closed` 或 `any`），统计符合条件的工单在各团队的数量：没有 `assignee`、或客服已删除（404）的工单记为团队 `unassigned`。按数量从多到少输出，数量相同按团队名字典序。

评测环境没有外网：接口返回的是题目自带的固定数据。Python 里的 `requests.get` 和 `urllib.request.urlopen` 由评测机直接应答，数据之外的地址返回 HTTP 404 和一段 JSON 错误信息。本题只支持 Python。
problem.input: 第一行用逗号分隔的优先级（`low`、`medium`、`high`、`urgent` 中的若干个，无空格）；第二行状态。
problem.output: 第一行团队数 m；随后 m 行，每行“团队 数量”。
problem.explanation: 样例 2：全部工单按团队统计。
hints: 先看 status_code：404 的客服不能调用 .json()["team"]。
同一个客服只需查询一次，用字典缓存。
